column2: Indicator
column3: Definition
column4: Measurement

column2: Air quality
Presence of Visible Air Pollution from Project Activities
column3: Assesses if dust, smoke, or emissions are noticeable in the project area.
column4: Observation of visible pollution (e.g., smoke from fuel use, industrial processes, construction dust).

column2: Complaints from the Community About Air Quality Issues
column3: Tracks whether residents, workers, or local authorities report air pollution problems
column4: Count and nature of complaints (from community meetings, surveys, or records).

column2: Change in Soil, Vegetation Condition in the Project Area
column3: Assesses whether the soil or the plants show signs of damage (e.g., leaf discoloration, stunted growth) due to air pollution.
column4: Visual assessment of the soil degradation or plant health near the project site.

column2: Water quality
Presence of Visible Water Contamination
column3: Assesses whether water in local rivers, lakes, or streams near the project appears polluted (e.g., oil, foam, discoloration).
column4: Visual inspection of water bodies for signs of contamination.

column2: Community Reports of Water Issues (Quality or Availability)
column3: Monitors whether locals experience water-related problems linked to the project (e.g., bad smell, reduced supply, health concerns).
column4: Number and type of complaints from community surveys or meetings.

column2: Changes in Animals, Vegetation, or Soil Health Near Water Sources
column3: Observes whether Animals and plants near water bodies are affected (e.g., Illnesses, deaths, unusual dryness, yellowing, erosion).
column4: Visual assessment of Animals, Soil, plant condition near rivers, lakes, or wetlands.

column2: The quality and effect of noise
Number of Community Complaints About Noise
column3: Tracks reports from residents, workers, or local institutions (e.g., schools, hospitals) about noise disturbances caused by the project.
column4: Review community feedback, complaints, or surveys regarding noise issues.

column2: Observation of Noise Disruption in Sensitive Areas (e.g., Schools, Hospitals, Homes)
column3: Assesses whether noise from the project is noticeable or disruptive in nearby sensitive locations.
column4: Visual and auditory assessment at different times of the day near schools, hospitals, and residential areas.

column2: Change in Noise Levels at Different Times of the Day
column3: Evaluates whether noise from the project increases significantly during specific times (e.g., early morning, late night).
column4: Field observation of noise patterns at various times of the day and week.

column2: Solid waste effect
Number of Community Complaints About Solid Waste Issues
column3: Tracks reports from residents, workers, or local authorities about problems related to waste disposal, accumulation, or pollution caused by the project, Including visual pollution caused by waste.
column4: Review community feedback, complaints, or surveys regarding solid waste issues.

column2: Visibility of Solid Waste Accumulation Near the Project Site
column3: Assesses whether solid waste from the project is noticeable and whether proper disposal methods are followed.
column4: Visual inspection of waste accumulation in and around the project area.

column2: Level of Recycling or Reuse of Project Waste
column3: Evaluates the percentage of the waste generated by the project is recycled, reused, safely disposed of, or dengorouse disposed of.
column4: Review of project waste management practices and records.

column2: Radiation effect:
Number of Community Complaints About Radiation Concerns
column3: Tracks reports from residents, workers, or local authorities about concerns related to radiation exposure from the project.
column4: Review community feedback, complaints, or surveys regarding radiation risks.

column2: Observation of Signs of Radiation-Related Environmental Damage
column3: Assesses whether there are visible signs of radiation exposure affecting plants, animals, or soil in the project area.
column4: Visual inspection of plant health, wildlife conditions, or unusual soil changes.

column2: Reports of Health Issues Potentially Linked to Radiation Exposure
column3: Monitors whether workers or nearby residents report symptoms or health conditions possibly linked to radiation.
column4: Review of health-related concerns raised in community discussions, workplace records, or local health authority reports

column2: Toxic and Dangerous Materials effect
Toxic and Dangerous Materials Effect (Solid, Liquid, or Gas)– Indicators for Annual Monitoring
column3: Tracks reports from residents, workers, or local authorities about concerns related to exposure to toxic or hazardous materials from the project.
column4: Review community feedback, complaints, or surveys regarding toxic material risks.

column2: Observation of Visible Contamination or Unsafe Handling of Toxic Materials
column3: Assesses whether there are visible signs of contamination (e.g., spills, improper storage, leaks) or unsafe handling of hazardous materials in the project area.
column4: Visual inspection of storage sites, waste disposal areas, or nearby land and water sources.

column2: Reports of Health Issues Potentially Linked to Toxic Material Exposure
column3: Monitors whether workers or nearby residents report symptoms or health conditions possibly linked to toxic material exposure.
column4: Review of health-related concerns raised in community discussions, workplace records, or local health authority reports.

column2: The Environmental impacts on natural plants, forests, and wildlife
Observation of Changes in Vegetation and Tree Cover
column3: Assesses whether the project has led to noticeable changes in plant health, tree cover, or deforestation in the area.
column4: Visual assessment of vegetation health and tree coverage near the project site.

column2: Reports of Wildlife Disturbance or Habitat Loss
column3: Tracks community or expert reports on the decline of wildlife populations, changes in animal migration, or habitat destruction caused by the project.
column4: Review of reports from local communities, conservation groups, or ecological assessments.

column2: Presence of Invasive Species in the Project Area
column3: Evaluates whether new invasive plant or animal species have been introduced due to project activities, impacting native ecosystems.
column4: Visual inspection of invasive species presence, combined with reports from local environmental monitoring groups.

column2: Environmental impacts of land use and management
Observation of Changes in Land Use and Aesthetic Impact
column3: Assesses whether the project has visibly altered the landscape, disrupted scenic areas, or changed land use patterns.
column4: Visual assessment of land use changes and aesthetic impact near the project site.

column2: Reports of Community Concerns About Social or Economic Impact
column3: Tracks feedback from residents, businesses, or local authorities regarding changes in economic activity, social structures, or community well-being due to the project.
column4: Review of community feedback, surveys, or discussions about economic and social impacts.

column2: Impact on Infrastructure and Public Services
column3: Evaluates whether the project has increased pressure on roads, utilities, schools, or healthcare facilities.
column4: Observations of infrastructure conditions and review of reports on service capacity issues.
